title: Kirigalpoththa
extract: Kirigalpoththa is the second-tallest mountain in Sri Lanka at 2,388 m (7,835 ft) above mean sea level, and is also the highest mountain in the country whose summit is accessible to the general public. The peak is situated near the city of Nuwara Eliya, within the Nuwara Eliya District. Only one seven-kilometre hiking trail provides access to the mountain's summit via the Horton Plains National Park, although the trail is not very popular.
